howToPlay: Berry excels at controlling space by throwing melted ice cream that heals allies and damages enemies over time. Use the Super to rush forward while spreading recovery zones, and utilize the gadgets to knock back enemies or extend the duration of the ice cream puddles.
gears: Equip SHIELD and HEALTH to increase survivability while supporting, or choose DAMAGE to capitalize on the sustained area attacks.
trait: This brawler suits a strategic player who enjoys manipulating the map to provide both offense and defense simultaneously.
